arxiv-2107-10720.creator: Hikaru Kawai, Kiyoharu Kawana
arxiv-2107-10720.description: Abstract Multi-critical point principle (MPP) is one of the interesting theoretical possibilities that can explain the fine-tuning problems of the Universe. It simply claims that “the coupling constants of a theory are tuned to one of the multi-critical points, where some of the extrema of the effective potential are degenerate.

arxiv-2205-02223.creator: Mashadi Ledwaba, Vukosi Marivate
arxiv-2205-02223.description: Abstract . This study aims to understand the South African political context by analysing the sentiments shared on Twitter during the local government elections. An emphasis on the analysis was placed on understanding the discussions led around four predominant political parties – ANC, DA, EFF and ActionSA.

arxiv-2208-11600.title: Multidimensional orthogonal matching pursuit: theory and application to high accuracy joint localization and communication at mmWave
arxiv-2208-11600.creator: Joan Palacios, Nuria González-Prelcic and Cristian Rusu
arxiv-2208-11600.description: Abstract Greedy approaches in general, and orthogonal matching pursuit in particular, are the most commonly used sparse recovery techniques in a wide range of applications. The complexity of these approaches is highly dependent on the size of the dictionary chosen to represent the sparse signal.

arxiv-2301-06958.title: RILS: Masked Visual Reconstruction in Language Semantic Space
arxiv-2301-06958.creator: Shusheng Yang, Yixiao Ge, Kun Yi, Dian Li, Ying Shan, Xiaohu Qie, Xinggang Wang
arxiv-2301-06958.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Shusheng Yang, Yixiao Ge, Kun Yi, Dian Li, Ying Shan, Xiaohu Qie, Xinggang Wang. Both masked image modeling (MIM) and natural language supervision have facilitated the progress of transferable visual pre-training. In this work, we seek the synergy between two paradigms and study the emerging properties when MIM meets natural language supervision.

arxiv-2308-04298.title: FRB 20121102A: images of the bursts and the varying radio counterpart 2015 FRB 20121102A: images of the bursts and the varying radio counterpart – References
arxiv-2308-04298.creator: L. Rhodes M. Caleb B. W. Stappers A. Andersson M.C. Bezuidenhout L. N. Driessen I. Heywood
arxiv-2308-04298.description: Abstract As more Fast Radio Bursts (FRBs) are being localised, we are learning that some fraction have persistent radio sources (PRSs). Such a discovery motivates an improvement in our understanding of the nature of those counterparts, the relation to the bursts themselves and why only some FRBs have PRSs.

arxiv-2312-06626.description: Abstract . We consider a certain class of infinitary rules of inference, called here restriction rules, using of which allows us to deduce complete theories of given models. The first instance of such rules was the ω \omega -rule introduced by Hilbert, and generalizations of the ω \omega -rule were first considered by Henkin.

arxiv-2503-20428.title: Evaluating Facial Expression Recognition Datasets for Deep Learning: A Benchmark Study with Novel Similarity Metrics
arxiv-2503-20428.creator: F. Xavier Gaya-Morey, Cristina Manresa-Yee, Célia Martinie, Jose M. Buades-Rubio
arxiv-2503-20428.description: Abstract This study investigates the key characteristics and suitability of widely used Facial Expression Recognition (FER) datasets for training deep learning models. In the field of affective computing, FER is essential for interpreting human emotions, yet the performance of FER systems is highly contingent on the quality and diversity of the underlying datasets.

arxiv-2504-10271.title: Change Your Perspective, Widen Your Worldview! Societally Beneficial Perceptual Filter Bubbles in Personalized Reality Conference: Purposeful XR: Affordances, Challenges, and Speculations for an Ethical Future at CHI 2025; April 26, 2025; Yokohama, Japan CCS: Information systems Personalization CCS:
arxiv-2504-10271.creator: Jannis Strecker, Luka Bekavac, Kenan Bektaş, Simon Mayer
arxiv-2504-10271.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Jannis Strecker, Luka Bekavac, Kenan Bektaş, Simon Mayer. Extended Reality (XR) technologies enable the personalized mediation of an individual’s perceivable reality across modalities, thereby creating a Personalized Reality (PR). While this may lead to individually beneficial effects in the form of more efficient, more fun, and safer experiences, it may also lead to perceptual filter bubbles since individuals are exposed predominantly or exclusively to content that is congruent with their existing beliefs and opinions.

arxiv-2508-18576.title: Brook-2PL: Tolerating High Contention Workloads with A Deadlock-Free Two-Phase Locking Protocol DOI: XXXXXXX.XXXXXXX Conference: Make sure to enter the correct conference title from your rights confirmation email; May 31–June 05, 2026; Bengaluru, India ISBN: 978-1-4503-XXXX-X/2018/06
arxiv-2508-18576.creator: Farzad Habibi, Juncheng Fang, Tania Lorido-Botran, Faisal Nawab
arxiv-2508-18576.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Farzad Habibi, Juncheng Fang, Tania Lorido-Botran, Faisal Nawab. The problem of hotspots remains a critical challenge in high-contention workloads for concurrency control (CC) protocols. Traditional concurrency control approaches encounter significant difficulties under high contention, resulting in excessive transaction aborts and deadlocks. In this paper, we propose Brook-2PL , a novel two-phase locking (2PL) protocol that (1) introduces SLW-Graph for deadlock-free transaction execution, and (2) proposes partial transaction chopping for early lock release.

arxiv-2510-12959.creator: Md Aminul Islam, Elena Zheleva, Ren Wang
arxiv-2510-12959.description: Abstract . User historical interaction data is the primary signal for learning user preferences in collaborative filtering (CF). However, the training data often exhibits a long-tailed distribution, where only a few items have the majority of interactions. CF models trained directly on such imbalanced data are prone to learning popularity bias, which reduces personalization and leads to suboptimal recommendation quality.

arxiv-2601-10189.creator: Jonathan Vieth, Annika Eichler, Arne Speerforck
arxiv-2601-10189.description: Abstract Decarbonizing the global energy supply requires more efficient heating and cooling systems. Model predictive control enhances the operation of cooling and heating systems but depends on accurate system models, often based on control volumes. We present an automated framework including time discretization to generate model predictive controllers for such models.

plos-pone-0002695.creator: Susanne Meis, Jorge Ricardo Bergado-Acosta, Yuchio Yanagawa et al.
plos-pone-0002695.description: PLOS ONE research article. Neuropeptide S (NPS) and its receptor are thought to define a set of specific brain circuits involved in fear and anxiety. pmc-11322514.creator: Qingdong Bao, Xiaoting Zhang, Zhankun Hao, Qinghua Li, Fan Wu, Kaiyuan Wang, Yang Li, Wenlong Li, Hua Gao
pmc-11322514.description: Highlights Polysaccharide-based microneedles are novel and emerging tools for ocular drug delivery and the research on the diagnosis and treatment of eye diseases is advancing at a fast pace.Microneedle devices constructed from polysaccharide molecules derived from ocular tissue have the potential to significantly enhance the efficiency of clinical treatments and improve patient compliance with therapeutic regimens.

pmc-11431317.creator: Elżbieta Szmida, Dorota Butkiewicz, Paweł Karpiński, Tomasz Rutkowski, Małgorzata Oczko-Wojciechowska, Maria Małgorzata Sąsiadek, Clifford J Steer
pmc-11431317.description: Background: Head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC) is one of the most prevalent cancers worldwide. The identification of molecular alterations adding to the individual risk of HNSCC development and progression is one of the most important challenges in studies on cancer genetics.

pmc-11434866.title: Risk Factors for Salmonella Infection in Children under Five Years: A Hospital-Based Study in Kilimanjaro Region, Tanzania
pmc-11434866.creator: Ephrasia A Hugho, Blandina T Mmbaga, Abdul-Hamid S Lukambagire, Grace D Kinabo, Kate M Thomas, Happiness H Kumburu, Tine Hald, David Rodríguez-Lázaro
pmc-11434866.description: Salmonella is among the causative agents for diarrhea worldwide, but its risk factors in Tanzanian children are poorly understood. A hospital-based cross-sectional study was conducted in Moshi, Kilimanjaro region, from July 2020 to November 2022 among children under five admitted with diarrhea. A questionnaire was administered to all parents/caretakers of the enrolled children.

pmc-11479371.title: Harmonic Vibration Analysis in a Simplified Model for Monitoring Transfemoral Implant Loosening
pmc-11479371.creator: Qingsong Zhou, Louis Raymond Francis Rose, Peter Ebeling, Matthias Russ, Mark Fitzgerald, Wing Kong Chiu
pmc-11479371.description: A simplified axisymmetric model of a transfemoral osseointegration implant was used to investigate the influence of the contact condition at the bone–implant interface on the vibrational response. The experimental setup allowed the degree of implant tightness to be controlled using a circumferential compression device affixed to the bone. Diametrically placed sensors allowed torsional modes to be distinguished from flexural modes.

pmc-11588206.creator: Mattia G Gollub, Thierry Backes, Hans-Michael Kaltenbach, Jörg Stelling, Anthony Mathelier
pmc-11588206.description: MotivationRelating metabolite and enzyme abundances to metabolic fluxes requires reaction kinetics, core elements of dynamic and enzyme cost models. However, kinetic parameters have been measured only for a fraction of all known enzymes, and the reliability of the available values is unknown.ResultsThe ENzyme KInetics Estimator (ENKIE) uses Bayesian Multilevel Models to predict value and uncertainty of KM and kcat parameters.

pmc-12563581.creator: Temitope Adeleke, Aston Knelsen-Dobson, Sean McGinity, Kyle M. Fontaine, Benedict C. Albensi, Banibrata Roy, Aida Adlimoghaddam

pmc-13485899.creator: Qiong Wu, Xuelin Yang, Minghuan Tang
pmc-13485899.description: BackgroundIn the context of deep integration of intelligent technologies into educational practice, how to balance the pressure from technology application with the intrinsic demands of teaching innovation, has become an important issue.
